evals.expected_output: The skill deterministically checks the Planner-authored SDD, resolves resources once, lowers it directly to caseplan.json, proves parity, and runs UiPath validation.
expectations: Runs check-sdd before any mutation
Uses inspect-sdd as the ordered lowering contract
Creates no intermediate task-list artifact
Writes registry evidence under case-build when resources require resolution
Runs check-caseplan, check-parity, and uip maestro case validate

evals.prompt: I want a new case but do not have an SDD yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill routes design to uipath-planner and does not author an SDD itself.
expectations: States that uipath-planner is the sole Case SDD author
Does not run a Case-design interview
Does not create an SDD or caseplan

evals.prompt: Build this case from an SDD whose task type is 'human-review'.
evals.expected_output: Preflight fails with a stable invalid-enum finding and exact SDD path before creating artifacts.
expectations: Returns a stable finding code
Reports the exact stage/task/type path
Does not guess a supported task type
Routes the contract defect back to Planner

evals.prompt: Build a case whose SDD names two unavailable agents and one unavailable action app.
evals.expected_output: Resolution batches the misses into one decision, creates only explicitly selected agents, and records placeholders only when accepted.
expectations: Performs one registry pull and deduplicated lookup pass
Asks one grouped fallback question
Never creates an action app inline
Persists exact resolution status and rationale
Reports placeholders as release blockers

evals.prompt: Build a case with sequential A then B and parallel C/D after B.
evals.expected_output: The artifact uses consecutive task groups for A/B, a shared group for C/D, and authored selected-tasks-completed rules; no edges are authored.
expectations: schema.edges is empty
Task groups encode the requested parallel structure
Dependency selectors resolve through semantic SDD locators
Parity verifies every task and rule

evals.prompt: Build a connector event trigger with a required folder and subject contains =vars.keyword.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the connection-scoped folder ID, preserves the mandatory filter, and writes identical compiled dynamic expressions to both trigger sinks.
expectations: Uses the read-only trigger spec before lowering
Does not duplicate the required event parameter in the user filter
Quotes the string variable interpolation
Copies the CLI caseShape losslessly from case-build spec cache

evals.prompt: Add a stage to an existing caseplan.json.
evals.expected_output: The skill routes to brownfield editing, preserves IDs and unrelated state, then validates the edited artifact.
expectations: Does not request or author a new SDD for a targeted edit
Preserves existing IDs
Adds reachability conditions and no edge
Runs deterministic and CLI checks

evals.prompt: Publish and debug this built Case.
evals.expected_output: The skill blocks release until local contract, SDD parity, CLI validation, preview, and explicit run/publish consent all pass.
expectations: Uses the checker before tenant operations
Does not treat placeholders as release-ready
Stops at destructive or externally visible gates
Reports exact commands and evidence
